convex_hull — 3D bounds op

• Data kinds: points → mesh

• Call: import meshrepair; meshrepair.convex_hull(V) (or ops3d.get("convex_hull"))

Usage

Convex hull of a point set -> `(V, F)` with outward-oriented triangles.
